title: Sort a pair
summary: Return two natural numbers in ascending order without changing the members.
preconditions: none: the function is total for natural-number pairs
postconditions: the first output is less than or equal to the second
the output pair contains exactly the two input values
invariants: the output sum equals the input sum
non_goals: sorting lists longer than two elements
ambiguity_notes: resolved: ordering is ascending and equality is allowed
